description: Re-explain something from the CURRENT conversation — a finding id (e.g. F7.2), a term, a decision, an acronym, or a paragraph you just wrote — in plain language for someone with zero context. Use when the user says "explain X simply", "what does that even mean", "eli5", "as if I don't know what you're talking about", "in plain terms / plain English", "break that down", or points at jargon or an open decision and wants it made understandable.
